profile_text.body:
Browse AI is a no-code web scraping and monitoring platform founded in 2020. The company describes itself as a tool that lets users scrape data from websites, monitor pages for changes, and turn websites into APIs without writing any code. Its core workflow involves pointing a scraping robot at a URL, after which the AI structures the extracted data automatically, with users able to customize the output. The platform includes features the company describes as dynamic content capture, built-in bot evasion, proxy management, automatic retries, and rate limiting, and it integrates with Google Sheets, Zapier, and REST APIs. A feature called Table Studio allows users to point at a URL, review AI-proposed columns, and approve or customize the schema before extraction begins.

The company's held facts list a single tracked product, Browse AI, categorized under Automation and Agents, with a noted compliance consideration around terms-of-service risk. Browse AI has been profiled on theworldofai.org since at least 2026, and no litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for the company.
